parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

meta.description: Extracts elements from a public LinkedIn profile page. Replace YOUR-USERNAME-HERE in the Profile URL node with your actual LinkedIn username. Extracted fields: name, headline, location, about, current_company, current_title, profile_image, experience[], education[], skills[], certifications[], languages[]. Uses JSON-LD structured data first, then HTML fallback selectors.
